lines: 东离西有多远，他叫我们的过犯离我们也有多远！

As far as the east is from the west
so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
As a father has pity on his children
so the Lord has pity on his worshippers.
因为他知道我们的本体，
思念我们不过是尘土。
因為他知道我們的本體，
思念我們不過是塵土。
For he knoweth our frame ; he remembereth that we are dust .

and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

to those who remember to obey his precepts.

and have his laws in mind to do them.

他的权柄统管万有。
耶和華在天上立定寶座；
他的權柄統管萬有。
The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens ; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

听从他命令、成全他旨意、有大能的天使，
都要称颂耶和华！
聽從他命令、成全他旨意、有大能的天使，
都要稱頌耶和華！
Bless the LORD
ye his angels
that excel in strength
that do his commandments
hearkening unto the voice of his word .

you angels of his
who are mighty in strength
who fulfill his word
obeying the voice of his word.
Give praise to the Lord
you his angels
who are great in strength
doing his orders
and waiting for his voice.

all ye his hosts ; ye ministers of his
that do his pleasure .

all you armies of his
you servants of his

all you his armies; and you his servants who do his pleasure.

You are clothed with light as with a robe; stretching out the heavens like a curtain:

that it should not be removed for ever .

and oil to make his face to shine
and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart .

how great is the number of your works! in wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of the things you have made.
那里有海，又大又广；
其中有无数的动物，
大小活物都有。
那裏有海，又大又廣；
其中有無數的動物，
大小活物都有。
So is this great and wide sea
wherein are things creeping innumerable
both small and great beasts .

There is the sea
great and wide
in which are innumerable living things
both small and large animals.
There is the great
wide sea
where there are living things
great and small

你张手，他们饱得美食。
你給他們，他們便拾起來；
你張手，他們飽得美食。
That thou givest them they gather : thou openest thine hand
they are filled with good .

they are filled with good .
You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
They take what you give them; they are full of the good things which come from your open hand.

Let the glory of the Lord be for ever; let the Lord have joy in his works:

Let my thoughts be sweet to him: I will be glad in the Lord.
